# VL API

VL API is a New API gateway that provides one OpenAI-compatible endpoint for multiple AI model providers.

## Public resources

- [Documentation](https://new-api.errorclub.club/docs): API setup and usage documentation.
- [Models and pricing](https://new-api.errorclub.club/pricing): Available models and current public pricing.
- [Service status](https://new-api.errorclub.club/service-status): Current model and provider availability.
- [Support](https://new-api.errorclub.club/support): Support and contact options.

Authentication is required for account, key, billing, and usage pages. API clients should use the base URL and credentials shown in the authenticated console.
